As a Reach Truck Driver, you will have varied tasks in the warehouse. You will work with pallets containing both large and small items and regularly handle fragile products. Therefore, it is important that you work carefully and always prioritize safety. You collect goods using replenishment slips, move them with the reach truck from bulk locations, and place them back in the correct location. Additionally, you pick orders from full pallets and verify that everything is correct before the goods continue in the process. You will work in a 2-shift system with times from 6:00 AM - 3:00 PM or 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM.
